example_sentences_in_bangla: পরীক্ষায় খারাপ ফল পেয়ে ছেলেটি মুখ মোড়া দিয়ে বসে রইল।
ভাইয়ের কথায় রাগ করে বোন মুখ মোড়া করল।
example_sentences_in_english: The boy sulked by covering his face after getting poor exam results.
The sister expressed her anger by turning her face away from her brother's words.
note: This idiom reflects traditional Bengali ways of expressing subtle emotions without direct confrontation.
